acceptedAnswer.text:
Where is Cape Cod Cannabis located?
					

					Cape Cod Cannabis Recreational Dispensary is located at 1446 US-6, Wellfleet, MA 02667. We’re conveniently located along Route 6 in the South Wellfleet shopping plaza, designed like a rest stop, for easy entry and exit with plenty of free parking, includes a bakery, liquor store, and U.S. Post Office for your convenience. Click here for directions. Cape Cod Cannabis is a licensed adult-use recreational dispensary serving residents and visitors alike in Barnstable, Bourne, Brewster, Chatham, Dennis, Eastham, Falmouth, Harwich, Hyannis, Mashpee, Orleans, Provincetown, Sandwich, Truro, Wellfleet, Yarmouth and beyond.
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												Where can I find weed near me on Cape Cod?
					

					If you’re searching for weed near me on Cape Cod, Cape Cod Cannabis is an adult-use recreational dispensary located at 1446 US-6 in Wellfleet, Massachusetts, in the South Wellfleet area of the Outer Cape. We’re open daily and offer a wide selection of recreational cannabis products. Customers 21+ can shop in-store or order online for convenient pickup with valid ID.
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												What is the legal age to purchase cannabis in Massachusetts?
					

					We welcome anyone 21 years of age or older with a valid Government ID (e.g., Drivers License, Passport, etc.) to verify your age upon entry. Unfortunately, we cannot accept expired MA ID’s unless, when already renewed, you bring the expired MA ID with the actual MA RMV documentation for the renewal. Unfortunately, we cannot accept any out-of-state or International ID’s that are expired. Note: We respect if you are wearing a mask when you enter but please know that, per regulations, we have to properly identify everyone who enters. You will be asked to momentarily remove (or lower) your mask for identification purposes. We thank you for your cooperation and understanding. 
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												What should I expect when visiting a dispensary for the first time?
					

					If it’s your first time visiting a dispensary in Massachusetts, the process is simple and welcoming. When you arrive, you’ll be asked to show a valid government-issued ID to confirm you are 21 or older. After check-in, you can browse the menu or speak with a knowledgeable staff member (often called a budtender) who can help you choose products based on your preferences and experience level. At Cape Cod Cannabis, you’ll find a variety of options including flower, pre-rolls, edibles, vapes, tinctures, topicals, CBD and concentrates. Our budtenders are here to answer questions and make recommendations, whether you’re looking to relax, sleep better, or try cannabis for the first time. Once you’ve made your selection, you’ll proceed to checkout—we accept cash and debit payment options. We also have an on-site ATM for your convenience. Overall, expect a safe, regulated, and educational experience designed to help you feel comfortable and informed…and NOT rushed. We also offer an online assistant (bottom left side of the website) to ask questions and lead you in the right direction. Please give us a call at (774) 383-3133 if you have further questions.
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												What do customers say about Cape Cod Cannabis?
					

					2026 Cape Cod Choice Awards: Best CBD Store Winner | Top 3 Best Cannabis DispensaryCustomers frequently mention our knowledgeable and friendly team, wide cannabis selection, personalized service, welcoming atmosphere, convenient Route 6 location, and overall dispensary experience. Read our recent customer reviews to see feedback directly from customers.
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												Can I leave a review for Cape Cod Cannabis?
					

					Yes. Visit our Leave Your Review page to share your experience on Google or Yelp.
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												What are the operating hours for Cape Cod Cannabis?
					

					We’re open 7 days a week. Please check our hours for the most up-to-date hours, including holiday schedules.
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												What cannabis products do you carry?
					

					Cape Cod Cannabis Dispensary in Wellfleet offers the largest selection of quality flower, pre-rolls, seeds, edibles, vapes, concentrates, syrups / tinctures, CBD, topicals, pet drops and more at the BEST prices on Cape Cod…something for every preference and experience level. Always worth the trip!
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												Is there a limit to how much cannabis I can buy?
					

					Yes. As of April 19, 2026, Massachusetts law allows you to purchase up to 2 ounces of flower (Recreational) or its equivalent in other cannabis products per day. Click here to visit our “Understanding the Daily Purchase Limit in MA” page for more information and to calculate your daily purchase. Recreational = 56 grams (flower) a day is the legal MA limit, which can constitute: •  Flower: Up to 56 grams (2 ounces).•  Edibles: A total of 1000mg THC, which is roughly 10 packs of 20 servings, each serving containing 5mg of THC.•  Concentrates: Up to 10 grams of cannabis concentrates, such as wax, shatter, or live resin (equivalent to 10 x 1g or 20 x 0.5g packages).•  Tinctures: A total of 10000mg = approximately 10 x 1000mg bottles, depending on the product’s potency and total THC content.•  Pre-roll Joints: 56 pre-roll joints, assuming each joint contains roughly 1 gram of flower.•  Vape Cartridges: Up to 20 x 0.5g cartridges or 10 x 1g cartridges/disposables. CBD = No LimitTopicals = No LimitAccessories = No Limit
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												Are your cannabis products tested for safety and quality?
					

					Yes. Cannabis products sold at Cape Cod Cannabis are required to meet Massachusetts testing and labeling requirements before being offered for retail sale.
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												What payment methods are accepted?
					

					We accept cash, debit cards and CanPay. A regular ATM is also located on-site for your convenience. Note: ATM and Debit transactions will incur a small third-party merchant fee.
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												Do you offer online ordering or pre-orders?
					

					Yes! Browse our full menu online or our Daily Offers page and place a pre-order for quick and easy pickup in-store. Once you finalize your order, it will be filled within 15 minutes and you will be able to pick it up at the store. Changes to pre-orders can be made during checkout at the store. PLEASE double check your phone number when entering your pre-order. We will not keep orders placed, past our store closing, the day of when the order was placed.
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												What should I know about cannabis?
					

					For a quick overview of the different types of cannabis products, terpenes, cannabinoids, strains and more please visit Intro to Cannabis 101.
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												Do you offer a Loyalty Program?
					

					Yes! We do offer a FREE Loyalty VIP Program where you can accumulate points that will be generated automatically and tracked for you for redemption. NOTE: Per MA Cannabis Control Commission regulations, Loyalty Points CANNOT be used for cannabis products. Currently, you CAN use your Loyalty Points toward Cape Cod Cannabis CBD, Accessories or Merch only. As soon as the CCC (Cannabis Control Commission) will approve or will remove the limitations on the promotions, you will be able to use these points toward all Cape Cod Cannabis products. That way you will not miss out on any points you could have accumulated if there were no limitations to begin with. In the meantime, you will get access to the VIP program. Not a Loyalty Program VIP member? JOIN FOR FREE IN-STORE TODAY! Already a Loyalty Program VIP member? Click here to Shop your Loyalty VIP Points.
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												What is your Return Policy?
					

					Cape Cod Cannabis is committed to customer satisfaction when it comes to the products we sell. RETURN POLICYPlease visit our Return Policy page for more information. CONTACT USIf you have any questions regarding our Return Policy please contact us or call (774) 383-3133.
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												What is your Privacy Policy?
					

					PRIVACY POLICYPlease visit our Privacy Policy page for more information. CONTACT USIf you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy please contact us or call us at (774) 383-3133.
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												Do you ship your Apparel?
					

					Yes! Our apparel, hats, beanies, sweatshirts, joggers and more can be shipped to you (within the United States only) via USPS Priority. Please visit our online store Blue Tail Apparel & Merch @ www.BlueTail.cc for convenient, safe and easy shopping and we will ship your order to you! Of course, you can always pre-order Cape Cod Cannabis apparel, accessories and merch for local pickup. * Please note:  Loyalty Points do not apply for purchases on BlueTail.cc at this time. In-store or pre-order (non-cannabis) purchases on CapeCodCannabis.com are applicable using your Loyalty Points.

												What cannabis products do you carry?
					

					Cape Cod Cannabis Dispensary in Wellfleet offers the largest selection of quality flower, pre-rolls, seeds, edibles, vapes, concentrates, syrups / tinctures, CBD, topicals, pet drops and more at the BEST prices on Cape Cod…something for every preference and experience level. Always worth the trip!
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												Is there a limit to how much cannabis I can buy?
					

					Yes. As of April 19, 2026, Massachusetts law allows you to purchase up to 2 ounces of flower (Recreational) or its equivalent in other cannabis products per day. Click here to visit our “Understanding the Daily Purchase Limit in MA” page for more information and to calculate your daily purchase. Recreational = 56 grams (flower) a day is the legal MA limit, which can constitute: •  Flower: Up to 56 grams (2 ounces).•  Edibles: A total of 1000mg THC, which is roughly 10 packs of 20 servings, each serving containing 5mg of THC.•  Concentrates: Up to 10 grams of cannabis concentrates, such as wax, shatter, or live resin (equivalent to 10 x 1g or 20 x 0.5g packages).•  Tinctures: A total of 10000mg = approximately 10 x 1000mg bottles, depending on the product’s potency and total THC content.•  Pre-roll Joints: 56 pre-roll joints, assuming each joint contains roughly 1 gram of flower.•  Vape Cartridges: Up to 20 x 0.5g cartridges or 10 x 1g cartridges/disposables. CBD = No LimitTopicals = No LimitAccessories = No Limit
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												Are your cannabis products tested for safety and quality?
					

					Yes. Cannabis products sold at Cape Cod Cannabis are required to meet Massachusetts testing and labeling requirements before being offered for retail sale.
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												What payment methods are accepted?
					

					We accept cash, debit cards and CanPay. A regular ATM is also located on-site for your convenience. Note: ATM and Debit transactions will incur a small third-party merchant fee.
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												Do you offer online ordering or pre-orders?
					

					Yes! Browse our full menu online or our Daily Offers page and place a pre-order for quick and easy pickup in-store. Once you finalize your order, it will be filled within 15 minutes and you will be able to pick it up at the store. Changes to pre-orders can be made during checkout at the store. PLEASE double check your phone number when entering your pre-order. We will not keep orders placed, past our store closing, the day of when the order was placed.
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												What should I know about cannabis?
					

					For a quick overview of the different types of cannabis products, terpenes, cannabinoids, strains and more please visit Intro to Cannabis 101.
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												Do you offer a Loyalty Program?
					

					Yes! We do offer a FREE Loyalty VIP Program where you can accumulate points that will be generated automatically and tracked for you for redemption. NOTE: Per MA Cannabis Control Commission regulations, Loyalty Points CANNOT be used for cannabis products. Currently, you CAN use your Loyalty Points toward Cape Cod Cannabis CBD, Accessories or Merch only. As soon as the CCC (Cannabis Control Commission) will approve or will remove the limitations on the promotions, you will be able to use these points toward all Cape Cod Cannabis products. That way you will not miss out on any points you could have accumulated if there were no limitations to begin with. In the meantime, you will get access to the VIP program. Not a Loyalty Program VIP member? JOIN FOR FREE IN-STORE TODAY! Already a Loyalty Program VIP member? Click here to Shop your Loyalty VIP Points.
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												What is your Return Policy?
					

					Cape Cod Cannabis is committed to customer satisfaction when it comes to the products we sell. RETURN POLICYPlease visit our Return Policy page for more information. CONTACT USIf you have any questions regarding our Return Policy please contact us or call (774) 383-3133.
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												What is your Privacy Policy?
					

					PRIVACY POLICYPlease visit our Privacy Policy page for more information. CONTACT USIf you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy please contact us or call us at (774) 383-3133.
				
							
					
												
															
								
													
												Do you ship your Apparel?
					

					Yes! Our apparel, hats, beanies, sweatshirts, joggers and more can be shipped to you (within the United States only) via USPS Priority. Please visit our online store Blue Tail Apparel & Merch @ www.BlueTail.cc for convenient, safe and easy shopping and we will ship your order to you! Of course, you can always pre-order Cape Cod Cannabis apparel, accessories and merch for local pickup. * Please note:  Loyalty Points do not apply for purchases on BlueTail.cc at this time. In-store or pre-order (non-cannabis) purchases on CapeCodCannabis.com are applicable using your Loyalty Points.

mainEntity.name: Where is Cape Cod Cannabis located?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Cape Cod Cannabis Recreational Dispensary is located at 1446 US-6, Wellfleet, MA 02667. We’re conveniently located along Route 6 in the South Wellfleet shopping plaza, designed like a rest stop, for easy entry and exit with plenty of free parking, includes a bakery, liquor store, and U.S. Post Office for your convenience. Click here for directions.

 

Cape Cod Cannabis is a licensed adult-use recreational dispensary serving residents and visitors alike in Barnstable, Bourne, Brewster, Chatham, Dennis, Eastham, Falmouth, Harwich, Hyannis, Mashpee, Orleans, Provincetown, Sandwich, Truro, Wellfleet, Yarmouth and beyond.

mainEntity.name: Where can I find weed near me on Cape Cod?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re searching for weed near me on Cape Cod, Cape Cod Cannabis is an adult-use recreational dispensary located at 1446 US-6 in Wellfleet, Massachusetts, in the South Wellfleet area of the Outer Cape. We’re open daily and offer a wide selection of recreational cannabis products. Customers 21+ can shop in-store or order online for convenient pickup with valid ID.

mainEntity.name: What is the legal age to purchase cannabis in Massachusetts?

acceptedAnswer.text:
We welcome anyone 21 years of age or older with a valid Government ID (e.g., Drivers License, Passport, etc.) to verify your age upon entry. Unfortunately, we cannot accept expired MA ID’s unless, when already renewed, you bring the expired MA ID with the actual MA RMV documentation for the renewal.

 

Unfortunately, we cannot accept any out-of-state or International ID’s that are expired.

 

Note: We respect if you are wearing a mask when you enter but please know that, per regulations, we have to properly identify everyone who enters. You will be asked to momentarily remove (or lower) your mask for identification purposes. We thank you for your cooperation and understanding.

mainEntity.name: What should I expect when visiting a dispensary for the first time?

acceptedAnswer.text:
If it’s your first time visiting a dispensary in Massachusetts, the process is simple and welcoming. When you arrive, you’ll be asked to show a valid government-issued ID to confirm you are 21 or older. After check-in, you can browse the menu or speak with a knowledgeable staff member (often called a budtender) who can help you choose products based on your preferences and experience level.

 

At Cape Cod Cannabis, you’ll find a variety of options including flower, pre-rolls, edibles, vapes, tinctures, topicals, CBD and concentrates. Our budtenders are here to answer questions and make recommendations, whether you’re looking to relax, sleep better, or try cannabis for the first time. Once you’ve made your selection, you’ll proceed to checkout—we accept cash and debit payment options. We also have an on-site ATM for your convenience.

 

Overall, expect a safe, regulated, and educational experience designed to help you feel comfortable and informed…and NOT rushed.

 

We also offer an online assistant (bottom left side of the website) to ask questions and lead you in the right direction. Please give us a call at (774) 383-3133 if you have further questions.

mainEntity.name: What do customers say about Cape Cod Cannabis?

acceptedAnswer.text:
2026 Cape Cod Choice Awards: Best CBD Store Winner | Top 3 Best Cannabis Dispensary

Customers frequently mention our knowledgeable and friendly team, wide cannabis selection, personalized service, welcoming atmosphere, convenient Route 6 location, and overall dispensary experience. Read our recent customer reviews to see feedback directly from customers.

mainEntity.name: Can I leave a review for Cape Cod Cannabis?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Visit our Leave Your Review page to share your experience on Google or Yelp.

mainEntity.name: What are the operating hours for Cape Cod Cannabis?

acceptedAnswer.text: We’re open 7 days a week. Please check our hours for the most up-to-date hours, including holiday schedules.

mainEntity.name: What cannabis products do you carry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cape Cod Cannabis Dispensary in Wellfleet offers the largest selection of quality flower, pre-rolls, seeds, edibles, vapes, concentrates, syrups / tinctures, CBD, topicals, pet drops and more at the BEST prices on Cape Cod…something for every preference and experience level. Always worth the trip!

mainEntity.name: Is there a limit to how much cannabis I can buy?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes. As of April 19, 2026, Massachusetts law allows you to purchase up to 2 ounces of flower (Recreational) or its equivalent in other cannabis products per day.

 

Click here to visit our “Understanding the Daily Purchase Limit in MA” page for more information and to calculate your daily purchase.

 

Recreational = 56 grams (flower) a day is the legal MA limit, which can constitute:

 

•  Flower: Up to 56 grams (2 ounces).

•  Edibles: A total of 1000mg THC, which is roughly 10 packs of 20 servings, each serving containing 5mg of THC.

•  Concentrates: Up to 10 grams of cannabis concentrates, such as wax, shatter, or live resin (equivalent to 10 x 1g or 20 x 0.5g packages).

•  Tinctures: A total of 10000mg = approximately 10 x 1000mg bottles, depending on the product’s potency and total THC content.

•  Pre-roll Joints: 56 pre-roll joints, assuming each joint contains roughly 1 gram of flower.

•  Vape Cartridges: Up to 20 x 0.5g cartridges or 10 x 1g cartridges/disposables.

 

CBD = No Limit

Topicals = No Limit

Accessories = No Limit

mainEntity.name: Are your cannabis products tested for safety and quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Cannabis products sold at Cape Cod Cannabis are required to meet Massachusetts testing and labeling requirements before being offered for retail sale.

mainEntity.name: What payment methods are accepted?

acceptedAnswer.text:
We accept cash, debit cards and CanPay. A regular ATM is also located on-site for your convenience.

 

Note: ATM and Debit transactions will incur a small third-party merchant fee.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer online ordering or pre-orders?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes! Browse our full menu online or our Daily Offers page and place a pre-order for quick and easy pickup in-store.

 

Once you finalize your order, it will be filled within 15 minutes and you will be able to pick it up at the store. Changes to pre-orders can be made during checkout at the store.

 

PLEASE double check your phone number when entering your pre-order.

 

We will not keep orders placed, past our store closing, the day of when the order was placed.

mainEntity.name: What should I know about cannabis?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a quick overview of the different types of cannabis products, terpenes, cannabinoids, strains and more please visit Intro to Cannabis 101.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer a Loyalty Program?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes! We do offer a FREE Loyalty VIP Program where you can accumulate points that will be generated automatically and tracked for you for redemption.

 

NOTE: Per MA Cannabis Control Commission regulations, Loyalty Points CANNOT be used for cannabis products.

 

Currently, you CAN use your Loyalty Points toward Cape Cod Cannabis CBD, Accessories or Merch only.

 

As soon as the CCC (Cannabis Control Commission) will approve or will remove the limitations on the promotions, you will be able to use these points toward all Cape Cod Cannabis products. That way you will not miss out on any points you could have accumulated if there were no limitations to begin with. In the meantime, you will get access to the VIP program.

 

Not a Loyalty Program VIP member? JOIN FOR FREE IN-STORE TODAY!

 

Already a Loyalty Program VIP member? Click here to Shop your Loyalty VIP Points.

mainEntity.name: Do you ship your Apparel?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes! Our apparel, hats, beanies, sweatshirts, joggers and more can be shipped to you (within the United States only) via USPS Priority. Please visit our online store Blue Tail Apparel & Merch @ www.BlueTail.cc for convenient, safe and easy shopping and we will ship your order to you!

 

Of course, you can always pre-order Cape Cod Cannabis apparel, accessories and merch for local pickup.

 

* Please note:  Loyalty Points do not apply for purchases on BlueTail.cc at this time.

 

In-store or pre-order (non-cannabis) purchases on CapeCodCannabis.com are applicable using your Loyalty Points.

mainEntity.name: Where is Cape Cod Cannabis located?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Cape Cod Cannabis Recreational Dispensary is located at 1446 US-6, Wellfleet, MA 02667. We’re conveniently located along Route 6 in the South Wellfleet shopping plaza, designed like a rest stop, for easy entry and exit with plenty of free parking, includes a bakery, liquor store, and U.S. Post Office for your convenience. Click here for directions.

 

Cape Cod Cannabis is a licensed adult-use recreational dispensary serving residents and visitors alike in Barnstable, Bourne, Brewster, Chatham, Dennis, Eastham, Falmouth, Harwich, Hyannis, Mashpee, Orleans, Provincetown, Sandwich, Truro, Wellfleet, Yarmouth and beyond.

mainEntity.name: Where can I find weed near me on Cape Cod?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re searching for weed near me on Cape Cod, Cape Cod Cannabis is an adult-use recreational dispensary located at 1446 US-6 in Wellfleet, Massachusetts, in the South Wellfleet area of the Outer Cape. We’re open daily and offer a wide selection of recreational cannabis products. Customers 21+ can shop in-store or order online for convenient pickup with valid ID.

mainEntity.name: What is the legal age to purchase cannabis in Massachusetts?

acceptedAnswer.text:
We welcome anyone 21 years of age or older with a valid Government ID (e.g., Drivers License, Passport, etc.) to verify your age upon entry. Unfortunately, we cannot accept expired MA ID’s unless, when already renewed, you bring the expired MA ID with the actual MA RMV documentation for the renewal.

 

Unfortunately, we cannot accept any out-of-state or International ID’s that are expired.

 

Note: We respect if you are wearing a mask when you enter but please know that, per regulations, we have to properly identify everyone who enters. You will be asked to momentarily remove (or lower) your mask for identification purposes. We thank you for your cooperation and understanding.

mainEntity.name: What should I expect when visiting a dispensary for the first time?

acceptedAnswer.text:
If it’s your first time visiting a dispensary in Massachusetts, the process is simple and welcoming. When you arrive, you’ll be asked to show a valid government-issued ID to confirm you are 21 or older. After check-in, you can browse the menu or speak with a knowledgeable staff member (often called a budtender) who can help you choose products based on your preferences and experience level.

 

At Cape Cod Cannabis, you’ll find a variety of options including flower, pre-rolls, edibles, vapes, tinctures, topicals, CBD and concentrates. Our budtenders are here to answer questions and make recommendations, whether you’re looking to relax, sleep better, or try cannabis for the first time. Once you’ve made your selection, you’ll proceed to checkout—we accept cash and debit payment options. We also have an on-site ATM for your convenience.

 

Overall, expect a safe, regulated, and educational experience designed to help you feel comfortable and informed…and NOT rushed.

 

We also offer an online assistant (bottom left side of the website) to ask questions and lead you in the right direction. Please give us a call at (774) 383-3133 if you have further questions.

Always worth the trip!

mainEntity.name: Is there a limit to how much cannabis I can buy?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes. As of April 19, 2026, Massachusetts law allows you to purchase up to 2 ounces of flower (Recreational) or its equivalent in other cannabis products per day.

 

Click here to visit our “Understanding the Daily Purchase Limit in MA” page for more information and to calculate your daily purchase.

 

Recreational = 56 grams (flower) a day is the legal MA limit, which can constitute:

 

•  Flower: Up to 56 grams (2 ounces).

•  Edibles: A total of 1000mg THC, which is roughly 10 packs of 20 servings, each serving containing 5mg of THC.

•  Concentrates: Up to 10 grams of cannabis concentrates, such as wax, shatter, or live resin (equivalent to 10 x 1g or 20 x 0.5g packages).

•  Tinctures: A total of 10000mg = approximately 10 x 1000mg bottles, depending on the product’s potency and total THC content.

•  Pre-roll Joints: 56 pre-roll joints, assuming each joint contains roughly 1 gram of flower.

•  Vape Cartridges: Up to 20 x 0.5g cartridges or 10 x 1g cartridges/disposables.

 

CBD = No Limit

Topicals = No Limit

Accessories = No Limit

mainEntity.name: Are your cannabis products tested for safety and quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Cannabis products sold at Cape Cod Cannabis are required to meet Massachusetts testing and labeling requirements before being offered for retail sale.

mainEntity.name: What payment methods are accepted?

acceptedAnswer.text:
We accept cash, debit cards and CanPay. A regular ATM is also located on-site for your convenience.

 

Note: ATM and Debit transactions will incur a small third-party merchant fee.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer online ordering or pre-orders?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes! Browse our full menu online or our Daily Offers page and place a pre-order for quick and easy pickup in-store.

 

Once you finalize your order, it will be filled within 15 minutes and you will be able to pick it up at the store. Changes to pre-orders can be made during checkout at the store.

 

PLEASE double check your phone number when entering your pre-order.

 

We will not keep orders placed, past our store closing, the day of when the order was placed.

mainEntity.name: What should I know about cannabis?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a quick overview of the different types of cannabis products, terpenes, cannabinoids, strains and more please visit Intro to Cannabis 101.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer a Loyalty Program?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes! We do offer a FREE Loyalty VIP Program where you can accumulate points that will be generated automatically and tracked for you for redemption.

 

NOTE: Per MA Cannabis Control Commission regulations, Loyalty Points CANNOT be used for cannabis products.

 

Currently, you CAN use your Loyalty Points toward Cape Cod Cannabis CBD, Accessories or Merch only.

 

As soon as the CCC (Cannabis Control Commission) will approve or will remove the limitations on the promotions, you will be able to use these points toward all Cape Cod Cannabis products. That way you will not miss out on any points you could have accumulated if there were no limitations to begin with. In the meantime, you will get access to the VIP program.

 

Not a Loyalty Program VIP member? JOIN FOR FREE IN-STORE TODAY!

 

Already a Loyalty Program VIP member? Click here to Shop your Loyalty VIP Points.

Yes! Our apparel, hats, beanies, sweatshirts, joggers and more can be shipped to you (within the United States only) via USPS Priority. Please visit our online store Blue Tail Apparel & Merch @ www.BlueTail.cc for convenient, safe and easy shopping and we will ship your order to you!

mainEntity.name: Is there a limit to how much cannabis I can buy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Massachusetts law allows you to purchase up to 1 ounce of flower or its equivalent in other cannabis products per day. Click here to visit our “Understanding the Daily Purchase Limit in MA” page for more information and to calculate your daily purchase. Recreational = 28 grams (flower) a day is the legal MA limit, which can constitute: 500mg of edibles (≈ 5 packs of 20 servings – 5mg ea.) OR 5g of concentrates (≈ 5 of 1g or 10 of 0.5g) OR 10 bottles of tincture (may vary based on potency) OR 28 pre-roll joints (≈ 28g worth of pre-rolls) OR 10 0.5g vape cartridges (≈ or 5 of 1g carts/disposables) CBD = No Limit Topicals = No Limit Accessories = No Limit

mainEntity.name: Where can I find weed near me on Cape Cod?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re searching for weed near me on Cape Cod, Cape Cod Cannabis is an adult-use recreational dispensary located at 1446 US-6 in Wellfleet, Massachusetts, in the South Wellfleet area of the Outer Cape. We’re open daily and offer a wide selection of recreational cannabis products. Customers 21+ can shop in-store or order online for convenient pickup with valid ID.

mainEntity.name: What is the legal age to purchase cannabis in Massachusetts?

acceptedAnswer.text:
We welcome anyone 21 years of age or older with a valid Government ID (e.g., Drivers License, Passport, etc.) to verify your age upon entry. Unfortunately, we cannot accept expired MA ID’s unless, when already renewed, you bring the expired MA ID with the actual MA RMV documentation for the renewal.

 

Unfortunately, we cannot accept any out-of-state or International ID’s that are expired.

 

Note: We respect if you are wearing a mask when you enter but please know that, per regulations, we have to properly identify everyone who enters. You will be asked to momentarily remove (or lower) your mask for identification purposes. We thank you for your cooperation and understanding.

mainEntity.name: What should I expect when visiting a dispensary for the first time?

acceptedAnswer.text:
If it’s your first time visiting a dispensary in Massachusetts, the process is simple and welcoming. When you arrive, you’ll be asked to show a valid government-issued ID to confirm you are 21 or older. After check-in, you can browse the menu or speak with a knowledgeable staff member (often called a budtender) who can help you choose products based on your preferences and experience level.

 

At Cape Cod Cannabis, you’ll find a variety of options including flower, pre-rolls, edibles, vapes, tinctures, topicals, CBD and concentrates. Our budtenders are here to answer questions and make recommendations, whether you’re looking to relax, sleep better, or try cannabis for the first time. Once you’ve made your selection, you’ll proceed to checkout—we accept cash and debit payment options. We also have an on-site ATM for your convenience.

 

Overall, expect a safe, regulated, and educational experience designed to help you feel comfortable and informed…and NOT rushed.

 

We also offer an online assistant (bottom left side of the website) to ask questions and lead you in the right direction. Please give us a call at (774) 383-3133 if you have further questions.

Always worth the trip!

mainEntity.name: Is there a limit to how much cannabis I can buy?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes. As of April 19, 2026, Massachusetts law allows you to purchase up to 2 ounces of flower (Recreational) or its equivalent in other cannabis products per day.

 

Click here to visit our “Understanding the Daily Purchase Limit in MA” page for more information and to calculate your daily purchase.

 

Recreational = 56 grams (flower) a day is the legal MA limit, which can constitute:

 

•  Flower: Up to 56 grams (2 ounces).

•  Edibles: A total of 1000mg THC, which is roughly 10 packs of 20 servings, each serving containing 5mg of THC.

•  Concentrates: Up to 10 grams of cannabis concentrates, such as wax, shatter, or live resin (equivalent to 10 x 1g or 20 x 0.5g packages).

•  Tinctures: A total of 10000mg = approximately 10 x 1000mg bottles, depending on the product’s potency and total THC content.

•  Pre-roll Joints: 56 pre-roll joints, assuming each joint contains roughly 1 gram of flower.

•  Vape Cartridges: Up to 20 x 0.5g cartridges or 10 x 1g cartridges/disposables.

 

CBD = No Limit

Topicals = No Limit

Accessories = No Limit

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Cannabis products sold at Cape Cod Cannabis are required to meet Massachusetts testing and labeling requirements before being offered for retail sale.

acceptedAnswer.text:

mainEntity.name: Do you offer online ordering or pre-orders?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes! Browse our full menu online or our Daily Offers page and place a pre-order for quick and easy pickup in-store.

 

Once you finalize your order, it will be filled within 15 minutes and you will be able to pick it up at the store. Changes to pre-orders can be made during checkout at the store.

 

PLEASE double check your phone number when entering your pre-order.

 

We will not keep orders placed, past our store closing, the day of when the order was placed.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer a Loyalty Program?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes! We do offer a FREE Loyalty VIP Program where you can accumulate points that will be generated automatically and tracked for you for redemption.

That way you will not miss out on any points you could have accumulated if there were no limitations to begin with. In the meantime, you will get access to the VIP program.

mainEntity.name: Where is Cape Cod Cannabis located?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Cape Cod Cannabis Recreational Dispensary is located at 1446 US-6, Wellfleet, MA 02667. We’re conveniently located along Route 6 in the South Wellfleet shopping plaza, designed like a rest stop, for easy entry and exit with plenty of free parking, includes a bakery, liquor store, and U.S. Post Office for your convenience. Click here for directions.

 

Cape Cod Cannabis is a licensed adult-use recreational dispensary serving residents and visitors alike in Barnstable, Bourne, Brewster, Chatham, Dennis, Eastham, Falmouth, Harwich, Hyannis, Mashpee, Orleans, Provincetown, Sandwich, Truro, Wellfleet, Yarmouth and beyond.

mainEntity.name: Where can I find weed near me on Cape Cod?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re searching for weed near me on Cape Cod, Cape Cod Cannabis is an adult-use recreational dispensary located at 1446 US-6 in Wellfleet, Massachusetts, in the South Wellfleet area of the Outer Cape. We’re open daily and offer a wide selection of recreational cannabis products. Customers 21+ can shop in-store or order online for convenient pickup with valid ID.

mainEntity.name: What is the legal age to purchase cannabis in Massachusetts?

acceptedAnswer.text:
We welcome anyone 21 years of age or older with a valid Government ID (e.g., Drivers License, Passport, etc.) to verify your age upon entry. Unfortunately, we cannot accept expired MA ID’s unless, when already renewed, you bring the expired MA ID with the actual MA RMV documentation for the renewal.

 

Unfortunately, we cannot accept any out-of-state or International ID’s that are expired.

 

Note: We respect if you are wearing a mask when you enter but please know that, per regulations, we have to properly identify everyone who enters. You will be asked to momentarily remove (or lower) your mask for identification purposes. We thank you for your cooperation and understanding.

mainEntity.name: What should I expect when visiting a dispensary for the first time?

acceptedAnswer.text:
If it’s your first time visiting a dispensary in Massachusetts, the process is simple and welcoming. When you arrive, you’ll be asked to show a valid government-issued ID to confirm you are 21 or older. After check-in, you can browse the menu or speak with a knowledgeable staff member (often called a budtender) who can help you choose products based on your preferences and experience level.

 

At Cape Cod Cannabis, you’ll find a variety of options including flower, pre-rolls, edibles, vapes, tinctures, topicals, CBD and concentrates. Our budtenders are here to answer questions and make recommendations, whether you’re looking to relax, sleep better, or try cannabis for the first time. Once you’ve made your selection, you’ll proceed to checkout—we accept cash and debit payment options. We also have an on-site ATM for your convenience.

 

Overall, expect a safe, regulated, and educational experience designed to help you feel comfortable and informed…and NOT rushed.

 

We also offer an online assistant (bottom left side of the website) to ask questions and lead you in the right direction. Please give us a call at (774) 383-3133 if you have further questions.

Always worth the trip!

mainEntity.name: Is there a limit to how much cannabis I can buy?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes. As of April 19, 2026, Massachusetts law allows you to purchase up to 2 ounces of flower (Recreational) or its equivalent in other cannabis products per day.

 

Click here to visit our “Understanding the Daily Purchase Limit in MA” page for more information and to calculate your daily purchase.

 

Recreational = 56 grams (flower) a day is the legal MA limit, which can constitute:

 

•  Flower: Up to 56 grams (2 ounces).

•  Edibles: A total of 1000mg THC, which is roughly 10 packs of 20 servings, each serving containing 5mg of THC.

•  Concentrates: Up to 10 grams of cannabis concentrates, such as wax, shatter, or live resin (equivalent to 10 x 1g or 20 x 0.5g packages).

•  Tinctures: A total of 10000mg = approximately 10 x 1000mg bottles, depending on the product’s potency and total THC content.

•  Pre-roll Joints: 56 pre-roll joints, assuming each joint contains roughly 1 gram of flower.

•  Vape Cartridges: Up to 20 x 0.5g cartridges or 10 x 1g cartridges/disposables.

 

CBD = No Limit

Topicals = No Limit

Accessories = No Limit

mainEntity.name: Are your cannabis products tested for safety and quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Cannabis products sold at Cape Cod Cannabis are required to meet Massachusetts testing and labeling requirements before being offered for retail sale.

mainEntity.name: What payment methods are accepted?

acceptedAnswer.text:
We accept cash, debit cards and CanPay. A regular ATM is also located on-site for your convenience.

 

Note: ATM and Debit transactions will incur a small third-party merchant fee.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer online ordering or pre-orders?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes! Browse our full menu online or our Daily Offers page and place a pre-order for quick and easy pickup in-store.

 

Once you finalize your order, it will be filled within 15 minutes and you will be able to pick it up at the store. Changes to pre-orders can be made during checkout at the store.

 

PLEASE double check your phone number when entering your pre-order.

 

We will not keep orders placed, past our store closing, the day of when the order was placed.

mainEntity.name: What should I know about cannabis?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a quick overview of the different types of cannabis products, terpenes, cannabinoids, strains and more please visit Intro to Cannabis 101.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer a Loyalty Program?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes! We do offer a FREE Loyalty VIP Program where you can accumulate points that will be generated automatically and tracked for you for redemption.

 

NOTE: Per MA Cannabis Control Commission regulations, Loyalty Points CANNOT be used for cannabis products.

 

Currently, you CAN use your Loyalty Points toward Cape Cod Cannabis CBD, Accessories or Merch only.

 

As soon as the CCC (Cannabis Control Commission) will approve or will remove the limitations on the promotions, you will be able to use these points toward all Cape Cod Cannabis products. That way you will not miss out on any points you could have accumulated if there were no limitations to begin with. In the meantime, you will get access to the VIP program.

 

Not a Loyalty Program VIP member? JOIN FOR FREE IN-STORE TODAY!

 

Already a Loyalty Program VIP member? Click here to Shop your Loyalty VIP Points.

acceptedAnswer.text:

RETURN POLICY

CONTACT US

PRIVACY POLICY

CONTACT US

mainEntity.name: Do you ship your Apparel?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes! Our apparel, hats, beanies, sweatshirts, joggers and more can be shipped to you (within the United States only) via USPS Priority. Please visit our online store Blue Tail Apparel & Merch @ www.BlueTail.cc for convenient, safe and easy shopping and we will ship your order to you!

 

Of course, you can always pre-order Cape Cod Cannabis apparel, accessories and merch for local pickup.

 

* Please note:  Loyalty Points do not apply for purchases on BlueTail.cc at this time.

 

In-store or pre-order (non-cannabis) purchases on CapeCodCannabis.com are applicable using your Loyalty Points.

As soon as the CCC (Cannabis Control Commission) will approve or will remove the limitations on the promotions, you will be able to use these points toward all Cape Cod Cannabis products. That way you will not miss out on any points you could have accumulated if there were no limitations to begin with. In the meantime, you will get access to the VIP program.

 

Not a Loyalty Program VIP member? JOIN FOR FREE IN-STORE TODAY!

 

Already a Loyalty Program VIP member? Click here to Shop your Loyalty VIP Points.

acceptedAnswer.text:

mainEntity.name: What is the legal age to purchase cannabis in Massachusetts?

mainEntity.name: What should I expect when visiting a dispensary for the first time?

acceptedAnswer.text:
If it’s your first time visiting a dispensary in Massachusetts, the process is simple and welcoming. When you arrive, you’ll be asked to show a valid government-issued ID to confirm you are 21 or older. After check-in, you can browse the menu or speak with a knowledgeable staff member (often called a budtender) who can help you choose products based on your preferences and experience level.

 

At Cape Cod Cannabis, you’ll find a variety of options including flower, pre-rolls, edibles, vapes, tinctures, topicals, CBD and concentrates. Our budtenders are here to answer questions and make recommendations, whether you’re looking to relax, sleep better, or try cannabis for the first time. Once you’ve made your selection, you’ll proceed to checkout—we accept cash and debit payment options. We also have an on-site ATM for your convenience.

 

Overall, expect a safe, regulated, and educational experience designed to help you feel comfortable and informed…and NOT rushed.

 

We also offer an online assistant (bottom left side of the website) to ask questions and lead you in the right direction. Please give us a call at (774) 383-3133 if you have further questions.

mainEntity.name: Is there a limit to how much cannabis I can buy?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes. As of April 19, 2026, Massachusetts law allows you to purchase up to 2 ounces of flower (Recreational) or its equivalent in other cannabis products per day.

 

Click here to visit our “Understanding the Daily Purchase Limit in MA” page for more information and to calculate your daily purchase.

 

Recreational = 56 grams (flower) a day is the legal MA limit, which can constitute:

 

•  Flower: Up to 56 grams (2 ounces).

•  Edibles: A total of 1000mg THC, which is roughly 10 packs of 20 servings, each serving containing 5mg of THC.

•  Concentrates: Up to 10 grams of cannabis concentrates, such as wax, shatter, or live resin (equivalent to 10 x 1g or 20 x 0.5g packages).

•  Tinctures: A total of 10000mg = approximately 10 x 1000mg bottles, depending on the product’s potency and total THC content.

•  Pre-roll Joints: 56 pre-roll joints, assuming each joint contains roughly 1 gram of flower.

•  Vape Cartridges: Up to 20 x 0.5g cartridges or 10 x 1g cartridges/disposables.

 

CBD = No Limit

Topicals = No Limit

Accessories = No Limit

CBD = No Limit

mainEntity.name: Is there a limit to how much cannabis I can buy?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes. As of April 19, 2026, Massachusetts law allows you to purchase up to 2 ounces of flower (Recreational) or its equivalent in other cannabis products per day.

 

Click here to visit our “Understanding the Daily Purchase Limit in MA” page for more information and to calculate your daily purchase.

 

Recreational = 56 grams (flower) a day is the legal MA limit, which can constitute:

 

•  Flower: Up to 56 grams (2 ounces).

•  Edibles: A total of 1000mg THC, which is roughly 10 packs of 20 servings, each serving containing 5mg of THC.

•  Concentrates: Up to 10 grams of cannabis concentrates, such as wax, shatter, or live resin (equivalent to 10 x 1g or 20 x 0.5g packages).

•  Tinctures: A total of 10000mg = approximately 10 x 1000mg bottles, depending on the product’s potency and total THC content.

•  Pre-roll Joints: 56 pre-roll joints, assuming each joint contains roughly 1 gram of flower.

•  Vape Cartridges: Up to 20 x 0.5g cartridges or 10 x 1g cartridges/disposables.

 

CBD = No Limit

Topicals = No Limit

Accessories = No Limit

Recreational = 56 grams (flower) a day is the legal MA limit, which can constitute:

 

•  Flower: Up to 56 grams (2 ounces).

•  Edibles: A total of 1000mg THC, which is roughly 10 packs of 20 servings, each serving containing 5mg of THC.

•  Concentrates: Up to 10 grams of cannabis concentrates, such as wax, shatter, or live resin (equivalent to 10 x 1g or 20 x 0.5g packages).

•  Tinctures: A total of 10000mg = approximately 10 x 1000mg bottles, depending on the product’s potency and total THC content.

•  Pre-roll Joints: 56 pre-roll joints, assuming each joint contains roughly 1 gram of flower.

•  Vape Cartridges: Up to 20 x 0.5g cartridges or 10 x 1g cartridges/disposables.

 

CBD = No Limit

Topicals = No Limit

Accessories = No Limit

acceptedAnswer.text:

Note: ATM and Debit transactions will incur a small third-party merchant fee.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer online ordering or pre-orders?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes! Browse our full menu online or our Daily Offers page and place a pre-order for quick and easy pickup in-store.

 

Once you finalize your order, it will be filled within 15 minutes and you will be able to pick it up at the store. Changes to pre-orders can be made during checkout at the store.

 

PLEASE double check your phone number when entering your pre-order.

 

We will not keep orders placed, past our store closing, the day of when the order was placed.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer a Loyalty Program?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes! We do offer a FREE Loyalty VIP Program where you can accumulate points that will be generated automatically and tracked for you for redemption.

 

NOTE: Per MA Cannabis Control Commission regulations, Loyalty Points CANNOT be used for cannabis products.

 

Currently, you CAN use your Loyalty Points toward Cape Cod Cannabis CBD, Accessories or Merch only.

 

As soon as the CCC (Cannabis Control Commission) will approve or will remove the limitations on the promotions, you will be able to use these points toward all Cape Cod Cannabis products. That way you will not miss out on any points you could have accumulated if there were no limitations to begin with. In the meantime, you will get access to the VIP program.

mainEntity.name: Where is Cape Cod Cannabis located?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Cape Cod Cannabis Recreational Dispensary is located at 1446 US-6, Wellfleet, MA 02667. We’re conveniently located along Route 6 in the South Wellfleet shopping plaza, designed like a rest stop, for easy entry and exit with plenty of free parking, includes a bakery, liquor store, and U.S. Post Office for your convenience. Click here for directions.

 

Cape Cod Cannabis is a licensed adult-use recreational dispensary serving residents and visitors alike in Barnstable, Bourne, Brewster, Chatham, Dennis, Eastham, Falmouth, Harwich, Hyannis, Mashpee, Orleans, Provincetown, Sandwich, Truro, Wellfleet, Yarmouth and beyond.

mainEntity.name: Where can I find weed near me on Cape Cod?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re searching for weed near me on Cape Cod, Cape Cod Cannabis is an adult-use recreational dispensary located at 1446 US-6 in Wellfleet, Massachusetts, in the South Wellfleet area of the Outer Cape. We’re open daily and offer a wide selection of recreational cannabis products. Customers 21+ can shop in-store or order online for convenient pickup with valid ID.

mainEntity.name: What is the legal age to purchase cannabis in Massachusetts?

acceptedAnswer.text:
We welcome anyone 21 years of age or older with a valid Government ID (e.g., Drivers License, Passport, etc.) to verify your age upon entry. Unfortunately, we cannot accept expired MA ID’s unless, when already renewed, you bring the expired MA ID with the actual MA RMV documentation for the renewal.

 

Unfortunately, we cannot accept any out-of-state or International ID’s that are expired.

 

Note: We respect if you are wearing a mask when you enter but please know that, per regulations, we have to properly identify everyone who enters. You will be asked to momentarily remove (or lower) your mask for identification purposes. We thank you for your cooperation and understanding.

mainEntity.name: What should I expect when visiting a dispensary for the first time?

acceptedAnswer.text:
If it’s your first time visiting a dispensary in Massachusetts, the process is simple and welcoming. When you arrive, you’ll be asked to show a valid government-issued ID to confirm you are 21 or older. After check-in, you can browse the menu or speak with a knowledgeable staff member (often called a budtender) who can help you choose products based on your preferences and experience level.

 

At Cape Cod Cannabis, you’ll find a variety of options including flower, pre-rolls, edibles, vapes, tinctures, topicals, CBD and concentrates. Our budtenders are here to answer questions and make recommendations, whether you’re looking to relax, sleep better, or try cannabis for the first time. Once you’ve made your selection, you’ll proceed to checkout—we accept cash and debit payment options. We also have an on-site ATM for your convenience.

 

Overall, expect a safe, regulated, and educational experience designed to help you feel comfortable and informed…and NOT rushed.

 

We also offer an online assistant (bottom left side of the website) to ask questions and lead you in the right direction. Please give us a call at (774) 383-3133 if you have further questions.

Always worth the trip!

mainEntity.name: Is there a limit to how much cannabis I can buy?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes. As of April 19, 2026, Massachusetts law allows you to purchase up to 2 ounces of flower (Recreational) or its equivalent in other cannabis products per day.

 

Click here to visit our “Understanding the Daily Purchase Limit in MA” page for more information and to calculate your daily purchase.

 

Recreational = 56 grams (flower) a day is the legal MA limit, which can constitute:

 

•  Flower: Up to 56 grams (2 ounces).

•  Edibles: A total of 1000mg THC, which is roughly 10 packs of 20 servings, each serving containing 5mg of THC.

•  Concentrates: Up to 10 grams of cannabis concentrates, such as wax, shatter, or live resin (equivalent to 10 x 1g or 20 x 0.5g packages).

•  Tinctures: A total of 10000mg = approximately 10 x 1000mg bottles, depending on the product’s potency and total THC content.

•  Pre-roll Joints: 56 pre-roll joints, assuming each joint contains roughly 1 gram of flower.

•  Vape Cartridges: Up to 20 x 0.5g cartridges or 10 x 1g cartridges/disposables.

 

CBD = No Limit

Topicals = No Limit

Accessories = No Limit

mainEntity.name: Are your cannabis products tested for safety and quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Cannabis products sold at Cape Cod Cannabis are required to meet Massachusetts testing and labeling requirements before being offered for retail sale.

mainEntity.name: What payment methods are accepted?

acceptedAnswer.text:
We accept cash, debit cards and CanPay. A regular ATM is also located on-site for your convenience.

 

Note: ATM and Debit transactions will incur a small third-party merchant fee.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer online ordering or pre-orders?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes! Browse our full menu online or our Daily Offers page and place a pre-order for quick and easy pickup in-store.

 

Once you finalize your order, it will be filled within 15 minutes and you will be able to pick it up at the store. Changes to pre-orders can be made during checkout at the store.

 

PLEASE double check your phone number when entering your pre-order.

 

We will not keep orders placed, past our store closing, the day of when the order was placed.

mainEntity.name: What should I know about cannabis?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a quick overview of the different types of cannabis products, terpenes, cannabinoids, strains and more please visit Intro to Cannabis 101.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer a Loyalty Program?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes! We do offer a FREE Loyalty VIP Program where you can accumulate points that will be generated automatically and tracked for you for redemption.

 

NOTE: Per MA Cannabis Control Commission regulations, Loyalty Points CANNOT be used for cannabis products.

 

Currently, you CAN use your Loyalty Points toward Cape Cod Cannabis CBD, Accessories or Merch only.

 

As soon as the CCC (Cannabis Control Commission) will approve or will remove the limitations on the promotions, you will be able to use these points toward all Cape Cod Cannabis products. That way you will not miss out on any points you could have accumulated if there were no limitations to begin with. In the meantime, you will get access to the VIP program.

 

Not a Loyalty Program VIP member? JOIN FOR FREE IN-STORE TODAY!

 

Already a Loyalty Program VIP member? Click here to Shop your Loyalty VIP Points.

mainEntity.name: Do you ship your Apparel?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes! Our apparel, hats, beanies, sweatshirts, joggers and more can be shipped to you (within the United States only) via USPS Priority. Please visit our online store Blue Tail Apparel & Merch @ www.BlueTail.cc for convenient, safe and easy shopping and we will ship your order to you!

 

Of course, you can always pre-order Cape Cod Cannabis apparel, accessories and merch for local pickup.

 

* Please note:  Loyalty Points do not apply for purchases on BlueTail.cc at this time.

 

In-store or pre-order (non-cannabis) purchases on CapeCodCannabis.com are applicable using your Loyalty Points.

pages.title: What Are Dabs? | Cape Cod Cannabis Recreational Dispensary in Wellfleet, MA
pages.metaDescription: What Are Dabs? Dabs. Concentrates. Extracts. Shatter. Wax. Crumble. Live resin. Budder. Honey. Isolates. Rosin. Diamonds. Snow. Crystals. Sauce. All of these terms refer to concentrated cannabis extracts that are flash vaporized. For those of you interested in a heavier high than what cannabis flower has to offer, you may want to explore dabbing concentrates as an option. The THC content typically ranges on average from 65 to 95 percent, whereas regular flower ranges on average from 15 to 30 percent. If you’re struggling to understand the need for so many different forms of extracts, just think of it like alcohol. Some people may prefer wine due to the flavor and lower alcohol content while some may prefer liquor to feel the strongest effects. It’s the same for dabs, but with a few more factors to consider. The most obvious difference between each extract is the texture and consistency. Some people favor a softer consistency that they can easily scoop with their dab tool, while others may choose something more firm and glass-like. Another difference is that some extracts contain a higher amount of terpenes which is desirable for those looking for an extremely aromatic, tasty experience. Others care more about their products simply having the highest THC content. Each extract brings something different to the table and it’s up to individual users to experiment and see what they prefer. I personally love solventless extracts, such as rosin. No solvents are utilized in the extraction process – only natural substances involving water, ice, heat, and/or air. This results in an unaltered profile that is extremely reminiscent of the whole flower it was extracted from, with superior taste and purity.
